1.title: The Hard Constraint: Building Around Human Attention in an Agent-First World — Zack Proser, WorkOS
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Human attention is now the hard constraint in agent-first development—agents can scale infinitely via APIs, but developers burn out by 11am because verification, judgment, and knowing-something-is-actually-solved still require human cognition under load.

2.title: How Meesho Became India’s Biggest Shopping App
2.author: Y Combinator
2.hook: Meesho pivoted from a social commerce marketplace (version 1) to a direct-to-consumer platform (version 5) while keeping the same core mission—"democratize internet commerce for a billion consumers"—and achieved 250M monthly users buying 2.5B orders/year by obsessively solving for mass-market India, not metro India.
